displayName: OCI-AI-DB-020: AI — Sensitive Data Exposure via RAG Output
description:
Detects exposure of sensitive data through RAG output that should have been filtered by access controls

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — sensitive data exposure via rag output

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_020", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0
